test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9644a0843ada9afcfe5f6901461e89cb1d068b7a30790478b8bdd3c50449c912.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:

Top-left, to-right and middle elements (all 3 elements) are interchanging their position.

Bottom 2 corner elements are interchanging their position with each other.

From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:

All 4 corner symbols are shifting in an anticlockwise direction.

Middle symbols are replaced by a new symbol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c377b41a50d6547d538f17f47251ddb2f69b764b1e4b14f99deb8151fb4100d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
